skill.name: twitter-automation
skill.description: Use the inference.sh belt CLI to manage Twitter/X posts, media posts, likes, retweets, DMs, follows, deletes, and profile lookups.
skill.summary: Run Twitter/X posting and engagement workflows through the inference.sh belt CLI.
skill.author: 101-skills

security_audit.summary: The skill is documentation-only, but it includes actionable belt and npx commands for installing external skills and performing authenticated Twitter/X actions. I confirmed real command-execution and account-mutation examples, while marking markdown fences, app identifiers, and ordinary documentation links as false positives. No prompt injection text was found.

remediation.suggestion: Pin trusted package sources, prefer signed releases, and tell users to review package provenance before installing related skills.
Require explicit user confirmation before posting, deleting, sending DMs, following users, liking, or retweeting from a connected account.
Document where belt stores credentials, how users can revoke access, and how to avoid exposing account tokens.
Use a local marketplace asset or make the remote image optional to reduce automatic third-party requests during rendering.

content.value_statement: Managing Twitter/X posts, media, DMs, and follow actions through separate tools is slow and error-prone. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code structured prompts for using the inference.sh belt CLI.
actual_capabilities: Post text tweets through the x/post-tweet app.
Create Twitter/X posts with media URLs through x/post-create.
Like, retweet, delete, and retrieve posts by ID.
Send direct messages, follow users, and retrieve user profiles.
Combine AI image or video generation with a media post workflow.
limitations: Requires the inference.sh belt CLI and an authenticated account.
Does not implement the Twitter/X API directly inside the skill.
Does not add rate-limit, anti-spam, or policy compliance checks.
Media posting requires a reachable media URL from another service.

use_cases.title: Publish Campaign Updates
use_cases.description: Prepare and send approved Twitter/X updates from a connected account using the belt CLI workflow.

use_cases.title: Share Product Announcements
use_cases.description: Draft a concise announcement, confirm the final text, and post it through the x/post-tweet app.

use_cases.title: Coordinate Media Posts
use_cases.description: Generate an image or video asset, collect its media URL, and create a Twitter/X post with that media.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Tweet
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the twitter-automation skill to draft a tweet about this update. Ask for confirmation before posting it to Twitter/X.

prompt_templates.title: Post With Media
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the twitter-automation skill to prepare a Twitter/X post with this message and media URL. Confirm the account action before running belt.

prompt_templates.title: Engage With a Post
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the twitter-automation skill to review this tweet ID and prepare a like or retweet action. Ask before changing the account.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Media Campaign
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the twitter-automation skill to plan an image or video post workflow. Generate the media first, then confirm the final Twitter/X post.

output_examples.input: Post a short update about a new feature release.
output_examples.output: A concise tweet draft, a confirmation request, and the intended Twitter/X posting action before any account change.

output_examples.input: Share this product image on Twitter/X with a launch caption.
output_examples.output: A polished caption, the selected media URL, and a confirmation step before creating the media post.

output_examples.input: Send a thank-you direct message to a new follower.
output_examples.output: A brief direct-message draft, the recipient identifier to verify, and a confirmation prompt before sending.

best_practices: Confirm every public post, DM, follow, like, retweet, or delete before running the command.
Review connected account permissions and revoke unused access after campaigns end.
Keep media URLs, tweet IDs, and recipient IDs explicit in the user request.
anti_patterns: Do not run engagement or DM actions in bulk without user review.
Do not post generated media until the user has reviewed the final asset and caption.
Do not paste private tokens, cookies, or account credentials into prompts.

faq.question: Does this skill post directly to Twitter/X?
faq.answer: It guides Claude, Codex, or Claude Code to use the inference.sh belt CLI for posting from an authenticated account.

faq.question: Does it require an API key?
faq.answer: The skill expects the belt CLI to be installed and authenticated. Follow the provider documentation for account setup.

faq.question: Can it post images or videos?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill shows media post workflows that use a media URL with the x/post-create app.

faq.question: Can it send direct messages?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes a direct-message workflow using a recipient identifier and message text.

faq.question: Does it protect against spam or policy violations?
faq.answer: No. Users must apply platform rules, rate limits, consent checks, and content review before publishing or messaging.

faq.question: Can it work with Claude Code and Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. The report declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code when the required CLI is available.
